## 前置讲义摘要（你必须基于这些已建立的认知继续，不要重复，要承接）

### u1-l1 项目全景：MMDetection3D 是什么

本讲介绍 MMDetection3D 项目全景：OpenMMLab 生态中基于 PyTorch 的通用 3D 检测工具箱，既是命令行工具也是 Python 库。它支持 LiDAR、相机、多模态 3D 检测与 3D 语义分割四大任务，各分室内/室外场景，主力数据集含 KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo、ScanNet 等。依赖上立于 MMEngine（训练引擎）、MMCV（视觉基础库）、MMDetection（2D 组件）三层，包入口以左闭右开区间断言版本。仓库四大目录分工：mmdet3d/ 存实现、configs/ 存实验描述、tools/ 为命令行入口、projects/ 孵化前沿项目。本讲引入的关键术语有：3D 框（中心、尺寸、朝向角七参数）、点云、单目 3D 检测、多模态、配置驱动与注册器路由，后者是贯穿全库的骨架模式。
### u1-l2 环境安装与版本验证

本讲分四个模块讲解 MMDetection3D 的环境安装与验证：依赖链条全景、setup.py 与 requirements、包入口版本断言、安装验证四步法。核心结论：依赖链为 PyTorch → mmengine/mmcv/mmdet → mmdet3d 的四层结构，因 mmcv 的预编译 CUDA 算子必须匹配本机 torch 与 CUDA 版本，安装顺序不可颠倒——先装 PyTorch，再用 MIM 安装三件套，最后可编辑安装（pip install -e .）mmdet3d；该命令只装 runtime 的十个包，不含 torch 与三件套，可选依赖经 extras 提供；setup.py 用 exec 读版本号、把 configs/tools 软链进 .mim 目录，本体不编译 CUDA 扩展。包入口三条断言以左闭右开区间限定 mmcv、mmengine、mmdet 版本（比较前须经 digit_version 数值化），是每次 import 都执行的运行时最后防线：缺库报 ModuleNotFoundError，越界报带修复建议的 AssertionError。验证按 pip list、对照区间、import mmdet3d、跑 demo 四层递进，静态检查不能替代动态检查。关键术语：依赖链条、可编辑安装、MIM、extras、左闭右开区间、版本断言、四层验证。
### u1-l3 跑通第一个推理 Demo

本讲以 PointPillars 对 KITTI 单帧点云（`.bin`，每点 4 个 float32）跑通首个推理 Demo。涉及模块：`demo/pcd_demo.py` 命令行入口、`LidarDet3DInferencer` 及其基类 `Base3DInferencer` 的主循环、推理专用加载器 `LidarDet3DInferencerLoader`、底层 API `init_model` 与 `inference_detector`。核心结论：推理分高层 Inferencer 一站式与底层 API 灵活可控两条路线，均经 `model.test_step` 前向；Inferencer 初始化时把测试管线首部的 `LoadPointsFromFile` 原地替换为可接受裸路径或 numpy 数组的加载器，其余 transform 不变；调用阶段按预处理、前向、可视化、后处理四段推进，产出 vis_lidar 图片与 preds JSON。关键术语：7 自由度 3D 框、`Det3DDataSample.pred_instances_3d`（含 bboxes_3d、scores_3d、labels_3d）、checkpoint 权重、测试管线 pipeline。另需记住：置信度阈值只影响可视化，JSON 保存全部预测；`inference_detector` 单帧返回 (result, data) 二元组；单目与多模态 demo 需额外提供含 cam2img、lidar2img 标定矩阵的 info pkl。
### u1-l4 仓库目录结构与源码地图

本讲绘制 MMDetection3D 仓库源码地图：顶层目录分实现（mmdet3d 主包、projects 前沿孵化区）、描述（configs、demo）、入口与文档（tools、docs、tests）三组。mmdet3d 包六大子模块呈星形依赖：structures 位于最底层，定义 3D 框、点云与 Det3DDataSample 等数据契约，被 datasets（数据集与 transforms 管线）、models（全部模型组件）、evaluation、visualization 共同依赖，engine 以 Hook 横切训练循环；registry.py 的 17 个注册节点是路由中枢，其 locations 参数即「注册节点→源码目录」对照表。tools/train.py 与 test.py 仅做读配置、覆盖参数、Runner.from_cfg、启动训练/测试五步流程；create_data.py 把原始数据转成 info pkl。configs/_base_/ 四件套（模型、数据集、日程、运行时）经 `_base_` 继承加增量覆盖构成实验配置。核心方法是 grep class 反查 config 中 type 的源码位置；带 mmdet. 前缀表示从 MMDetection 跨库借用。VoxelNet 检测器一次贯穿八个模型子目录，可作为后续单元的阅读主线。
### u1-l5 配置系统入门：一个配置文件如何描述整个实验

本讲讲解 MMDetection3D 配置系统，分四个模块：配置即 Python、`_base_` 继承合并、四要素精读、命令行覆盖。核心结论：配置文件是被 `Config.fromfile` 执行的普通 Python，`dict(type='类名', ...)` 是描述一切模块的统一语法，`type` 字符串由注册器路由到真实类，`mmdet.` 前缀表示跨库借用；「中间变量」（如 voxel_size）先求值后合并、不跨文件共享。`_base_` 四件套（models/datasets/schedules/runtime）按「dict 递归合并、list 整体替换、后继承者覆盖前者」规则组合。model 块是 VoxelNet 及六大子组件嵌套的对象树；需区分 model 内部 train_cfg（assigner 等）与顶层 train_cfg（epoch 数）两个同名键。数据块含 RepeatDataset 包装、pipeline、KittiMetric 评估器。runtime 块（default_scope、default_hooks、load_from/resume）全库共用。`--cfg-options` 经 `merge_from_dict` 实现免改文件的临时覆盖，`--work-dir` 优先级为 CLI > 配置文件 > 文件名默认。PointPillars 160e 即 80 轮 × RepeatDataset(2)。
### u2-l1 三大坐标系与 Box3DMode/Coord3DMode

本讲阐明 mmdet3d 最底层的坐标系约定：三套右手坐标系 LIDAR（x 前 z 上，室外）、CAM（z 前 y 下，单目与 KITTI 标注）、DEPTH（y 前 z 上，室内），重力轴即 yaw 旋转轴分别为 z/y/z。7 自由度框（中心坐标、尺寸、yaw）的语义依赖坐标系，yaw=0 时朝向恒与 dx 边平行；坐标系转换须同时改写坐标（乘 rt_mat，可为含平移的齐次矩阵）、尺寸（LIDAR 与 CAM 互换 y、z 分量）与 yaw（经 limit_period 归一到 [-π, π)）。Box3DMode.convert 是框转换引擎，返回目标坐标系对应子类；Coord3DMode.convert 是框与点云的统一入口，转点只旋转前 3 维并保留属性列，裸数组转框须显式 is_point=False；BasePoints 点云家族（LiDAR/Camera/DepthPoints）与框子类平行，convert_to 为其语法糖。真实跨传感器转换依赖标定矩阵：KITTI 的 lidar2cam（R0_rect @ Tr_velo_to_cam）存于 info pkl，数据集类取逆后把相机系标注转回 LiDAR 系。此约定是后续框容器、点云结构与 Det3DDataSample 讲义的基础。
### u2-l2 BaseInstance3DBoxes：7 自由度 3D 框的抽象

本讲解读 mmdet3d 最底层的 BaseInstance3DBoxes 及 LiDAR/Camera/Depth 三个子类。基类是 (N, box_dim) 张量的包装类，每行为中心、尺寸加 yaw 共 7 自由度，默认锚点为底面中心，构造时按 origin 换算锚点，6 维输入自动补假 yaw 并置 with_yaw=False。关键术语：bottom_center/gravity_center 等只读属性族、bev 与 nearest_bev 两种鸟瞰图投影、in_range_bev/in_range_3d 范围过滤、limit_period 角度折叠，以及 3D IoU 分解为 BEV 旋转 IoU 乘高度交集。三子类差异全源于坐标系：CAM 的 y 轴向下，须重写 height_overlaps 与 bev（取 x-z 平面且 yaw 取负）；Depth 无 yaw 框旋转后取轴对齐外接矩形，用于 ScanNet 室内检测。rotate/flip 借 rotation_3d_in_axis 用同一旋转矩阵同步点云与框，是数据增强中刚体一致的实现位置。
### u2-l3 点云结构：BasePoints 与三个坐标系子类

本讲剖析 MMDetection3D 的点云容器族。BasePoints 以 (N, points_dim) 的 float32 张量承载点云：前 3 列固定为坐标，属性列（强度、高度、颜色）语义由 attribute_dims 登记，rotation_axis 记录重力轴。translate/rotate/flip/scale 四个刚体变换均原地修改且只动坐标列，rotate 返回矩阵供 3D 框同步变换。LiDARPoints、CameraPoints、DepthPoints 三个子类极薄，只定重力轴（LiDAR/Depth 为 z、CAM 为 y）、flip 方向（horizontal 翻横向轴、vertical 翻前向轴、重力轴不翻）与 convert_to 的源坐标系。convert_to 是 Coord3DMode.convert_point 的语法糖：克隆后坐标列乘 rt_mat、属性列拼回、按目标子类重包装；默认矩阵仅描述方向约定，真实跨传感器须传标定矩阵。管线中 LoadPointsFromFile 经 get_points_type 生产点对象，RandomFlip3D、GlobalRotScaleTrans、PointsRangeFilter 等消费其变换与掩码过滤；new_point 与框侧 new_box 为配套工厂。
### u2-l4 Det3DDataSample：贯穿训练推理的数据契约

本讲讲解 mmdet3d 的数据契约 Det3DDataSample。它继承 mmdet 的 DetDataSample，以 property 三件套声明 gt_instances_3d、pred_instances_3d、多模态专用的 pts/img_pred_instances_3d、点级 gt/pred_pts_seg 等字段，setter 的 dtype 断言构成运行时类型防线。实例级数据装 InstanceData（N 实例同长），点级数据装 PointData（全一维、按点同长、可整体索引），eval_ann_info 是唯一裸 dict 字段；metainfo 与 data fields 分区存放，sample_idx、box_type_3d 等元信息全流程共享。生命周期主线：Pack3DDetInputs 按四组键名路由表生产 dict(inputs, data_samples) 并剥去 gt_ 前缀；预处理器追加 batch_input_shape 等 metainfo；模型 loss 模式读真值、predict 模式经 add_pred_to_datasample 写预测（键名由 bbox3d2result 统一）；评估器（如 KittiMetric）以 pred_instances_3d 与 sample_idx 消费结果。
### u3-l1 Det3DDataset 基类剖析

本讲剖析 mmdet3d 检测数据集基类 Det3DDataset：数据集类管「读什么」、pipeline 管「怎么变」，二者以 data dict 交接。info pkl 顶层为 metainfo+data_list，读 pkl 与逐条回调 parse_data_info 由 mmengine BaseDataset 完成。构造参数三大约定：modality（use_lidar/use_camera 开关，缺失补 False、不能全关）、metainfo（子集训练经 label_mapping 将未选类别映射为 -1）、box_type_3d（经 get_box_type 解析为框子类与 Box3DMode）。加工链：parse_data_info 加工「帧」——拼绝对路径、提升标定、按训练/测试生成 ann_info 或 eval_ann_info；parse_ann_info 加工「实例」——instances 转数组、name_mapping 改名、label_mapping 换标签，裸数组到 3D 框对象的包装与坐标系转换由子类完成（KITTI 相机系转雷达系、nuScenes 拼速度与多相机拆分、ScanNet 无 yaw 深度框）。prepare_data 是与管线的交接面：深拷贝、注入 box_type_3d/box_mode_3d、管线前后两次过滤空真值，最终经 pipeline 产出 dict(inputs, data_samples) 即 Det3DDataSample。
### u3-l2 数据准备：从原始数据集到 info pkl

本讲讲解 info pkl 的离线生成链路。`tools/create_data.py` 是数据准备总调度台：按数据集名分发到各 prep 函数，统一执行「生成 v1 info → 升级为 v2 标准格式 → 生成 GT 数据库」三步。KITTI 按 ImageSets 划分收帧，派生每框点数 num_points_in_gt，裁剪后的 velodyne_reduced 是训练配置硬依赖；nuScenes 从 json 数据库物化出六相机信息、沿 prev 指针回溯的 sweeps、雷达系速度与 valid_flag；室内三件套（SUN RGB-D/ScanNet/S3DIS）另产分割 info 与 1/ln(1.2+n) 形式的逐类 label weight。核心结论：info pkl 是 converter 与 dataset 的契约边界——转换器离线读原始数据并算好派生量，数据集类在线只做轻量加工；v2 格式顶层为 metainfo 加 data_list，单条分 images、lidar_points、instances 三段式。关键术语：v1/v2 格式升级、extra-tag 文件名前缀、GT 数据库、data 目录符号链接。
### u3-l3 室外数据集：KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo、Lyft

本讲对比 mmdet3d 四个室外数据集类：KITTI、nuScenes 直接继承 Det3DDataset；Waymo 的 info 由 converter 按 KITTI 风格生成，故继承 KittiDataset，另加 load_interval 抽帧与 cam_sync_instances 相机同步标注；Lyft 仅重写 parse_ann_info。parse_data_info 差异：KITTI 独有地面平面 plane 并由相机系转至雷达系，nuScenes 多视觉模式一帧拆六相机样本。parse_ann_info 三条路线：KITTI 用 inv(lidar2cam) 把相机系标注逆变换到雷达系；nuScenes/Lyft 用 origin=(0.5,0.5,0.5) 换锚点（几何中心到底面中心），nuScenes 再过滤无效框并拼接速度成 9 维框；Waymo 跳级调用基类、直接包装已是雷达系的数组。sweeps 聚合发生在 pipeline 而非数据集类：LoadPointsFromMultiSweeps 消费 points 与 lidar_sweeps，用 lidar2sensor 和时间差把历史帧拼入当前点云，产出 x、y、z、Δt 四维点。评估也不在数据集类内：由 val_evaluator 挂接的 KittiMetric/NuScenesMetric 经 process→compute_metrics 完成，GT 来自 metric 自带的 ann_file。关键术语：LiDARInstance3DBoxes、with_yaw、lidar2img、eval_ann_info。
### u3-l4 室内数据集：ScanNet 与 SUN RGB-D

本讲剖析 mmdet3d 两大室内检测数据集类 ScanNetDataset 与 SUNRGBDDataset。二者同用 Depth 坐标系与 DepthInstance3DBoxes，但框形态不同：ScanNet 为 6 维轴对齐框（with_yaw=False），SUN RGB-D 为 7 维带朝向框，该差异传导至 VoteNet bbox coder 的 with_rot 配置。两个类均极薄：parse_data_info 只注入室内特有字段（axis_align_matrix、逐点 mask 路径或 depth2img），parse_ann_info 只做「裸数组 → 框对象」的包装，其余复用 Det3DDataset 基类。ScanNet 的关键约定是「框天生对齐、点需手动掰」：标注框已被 converter 预对齐，管线用 GlobalAlignment 把点云搬到同一坐标系。室内独有的逐点 mask（pts_instance_mask / pts_semantic_mask）遵循长度恒等于点数的不变量：由 LoadAnnotations3D 加载、PointSegClassMapping 借 seg_label_mapping 重映射、PointSample 同步索引。评估统一走 IndoorMetric 的 mAP@0.25/0.5，GT 经 eval_ann_info 随 Det3DDataSample 流转。
### u3-l5 数据加载 Transforms：LoadPointsFromFile 一族

本讲解读 mmdet3d 数据管线最前端的加载类。核心结论：load_dim 是 .bin 文件每点的物理列数，use_dim 是建模保留哪几列，二者解耦；点云经 reshape、列裁剪、归一化后由 get_points_type 按坐标系包装成 BasePoints 对象写入 points 键。LoadPointsFromMultiSweeps 用 lidar2sensor 矩阵把 nuScenes 历史 sweep 刚体对齐到当前帧，复用第 5 列存时间差 Δt，默认 use_dim=[0,1,2,4]，输出 (x,y,z,Δt) 四维点。图像加载类只从 info 提取 cam2img、lidar2cam 标定（离线算好、在线轻取），多视角图 pad 后堆叠。LoadAnnotations3D 按 with_* 开关把 ann_info 按需提升为根级 gt_* 键供增强类同步变换。管线终点 Pack3DDetInputs 用四张路由表与 meta_keys 三级查找把各键分发进 inputs 与 data_samples。关键警示：use_dim 与模型 in_channels 强耦合，同为 4 维但第 4 维语义不同（KITTI 是强度，nuScenes 是 Δt）。
### u3-l6 3D 数据增强：RandomFlip3D 与 GlobalRotScaleTrans

本讲剖析 mmdet3d 训练管线的 3D 数据增强：RandomFlip3D 的 BEV 镜像（sync_2d 使 2D 图像与 3D 点云共用翻转决策）、GlobalRotScaleTrans 的 R→S→T 全局变换、ObjectNoise 的逐目标扰动（numba 加速、碰撞测试、仅框内点跟随移动），以及 ObjectRangeFilter、PointsRangeFilter、PointShuffle 的收尾过滤与洗牌。核心结论：增强链按「内容增改→全局几何变换→范围过滤」三段式排序，过滤必须置于最后，否则增强会把目标推出感知范围而污染监督；点云与 3D 框的同步变换靠「框对象的方法顺带变换点对象」实现，二者共用同一矩阵。关键术语：审计线索 transformation_3d_flow 及 pcd_rotation、pcd_rotation_angle、pcd_scale_factor、pcd_trans 等元信息键，它们被写入 data dict，供多模态融合层 apply_3d_transformation 按倒序逆变换还原坐标。
### u3-l7 GT 数据库采样：ObjectSample 与 DataBaseSampler

本讲剖析真值增广（GT-Aug）的四个最小模块：离线建库、采样器构建、在线采样粘贴、合入当前帧。关键设计是点框分离：建库时（create_groundtruth_database）目标点云存成以框中心为原点的相对坐标 `.bin`，dbinfos 记录绝对框位（box3d_lidar）与点数等元信息，素材因此可贴回任意位置。DataBaseSampler 初始化时读库并做一次性入库过滤（filter_by_min_points 门槛在此生效），每类建 BatchSampler 无放回洗牌队列；sample_all 每帧按类「补到上限」计算名额，经 BEV 分离轴碰撞测试（先贴优先）筛除重叠样本，再读点、平移还原、可选地面校正。ObjectSample 拼接标签、重建框，点云先删粘贴框内原有点再拼接。核心结论：anchors 不在数据流中，由检测头每次前向现算并经 assigner 重新分配，故粘贴新 gt 无需修复对应关系；group_ids 未被消费、sample_2d 主库不可用属遗留事实。
### u3-l8 Pack3DDetInputs：数据管线的出口

本讲精读数据管线最后一环 Pack3DDetInputs（formating.py）：它把增强后的平铺 results dict 翻译成模型契约 dict(inputs, data_samples)，必须置于管线最后。keys 是白名单，按四张路由表分发：points/img 进 inputs，3D/2D 实例键与分割键分别进 gt_instances_3d、gt_instances、gt_pts_seg（剥 gt_ 前缀），未登记键 fail-fast 报 NotImplementedError；测试只打包输入键，训练按任务追加监督键。meta_keys 走根级、images、lidar_points 三级查找，images 存在时第三级被 elif 短路。打包时完成张量化（to_tensor、points 剥 BasePoints 壳、img HWC→CHW、float64 降 float32），3D 框对象原样存活进损失函数；eval_ann_info 走特例通道供室内评估。产物再经 pseudo_collate 与 Det3DDataPreprocessor（堆叠图像、可选体素化、追加 metainfo）进入模型 forward 三模式。

本讲解剖 mmdet3d 的注册器（Registry）机制，即配置中 type 字符串到真实 Python 类的路由中枢。核心结论：registry.py 实际定义 21 个注册节点（头注释的 17 已漂移），每个节点以 mmengine 根注册器为 parent，并声明 locations 自动导入目录；注册由 @register_module() 装饰器在模块被 import 时以副作用完成，import mmdet3d 本身不注册任何类。查找链路三段式：本级注册表 → locations 懒导入 → parent 链上溯；带 mmdet./mmdet3d. 前缀的 type 经 scope 切换跨项目借模块。build 是递归工厂，一行 MODELS.build 滚出整棵对象树。引入术语：parent、locations、懒导入、default_scope、别名注册、TASK_UTILS。另澄清 PointPillars 并非注册名，而是 VoxelNet 加 PillarFeatureNet 等组件的组合，为后续检测器分层与自定义模块打基础。

### u4-l3 Det3DDataPreprocessor 与体素化预处理

本讲核心是模型前向的 batch 预处理与体素化。Det3DDataPreprocessor 是数据进入检测器的第一站：图像经归一化、pad 后堆叠为四维张量（img 改名 imgs）；点云不堆叠、保留张量列表，可另产 voxels 字典。VoxelizationByGridShape 封装 mmcv 编译算子，分 hard（定长三件套 voxels/coors/num_points，受每格点数与体素总数双上限约束、超限静默丢点，故调用前应洗牌）与 dynamic（仅每点格坐标，聚合推迟到网络内）两种模式；voxel_size 与 grid_shape 互斥可互推但公式不对称。voxelize() 把帧号 pad 进 coors 第 0 列编码 batch，后三列为 (z,y,x) 倒序，VoxelNet 用末行首列加一恢复 batch_size。另导览 cylindrical、minkunet 两种分割体素化，以及 numpy 版 VoxelGenerator（真实调用方是数据管线的 VoxelBasedPointSampler，靠 coor_to_voxelidx 查找表 O(1) 判格）。关键概念：体素、柱体（z 维仅一层格即 PointPillars 的 pillar）、voxel_dict 四种风味与 voxel_centers 反算。

### u5-l3 SECONDFPN：从 3D 特征到多尺度 BEV 特征

SECONDFPN 是 SECOND backbone 与 Anchor3DHead 之间的 neck：把多尺度 BEV 特征对齐到同一分辨率后沿通道维 concat，输出单级大通道特征图（单元素列表），而非经典 FPN 的相加融合与多级输出。每条支路（deblock）=采样层+归一化+ReLU 三件套：stride>1 走 kernel=stride 的反卷积，实现整数倍无重叠上采样；stride<1（如 0.5）换算成普通卷积下采样，CenterPoint 以 upsample_strides=[0.5,1,2] 把汇聚点选在中间分辨率以省算力。norm_cfg 可配（默认 BN，可换 GN），激活函数硬编码为 ReLU 不可配置。两条硬契约：neck 输入通道逐元素等于 backbone 输出通道；head 的 in_channels 必须等于各支路 out_channels 之和。调用链上 VoxelNet.extract_feat 经 with_neck 调用 neck，其输出由 Anchor3DHead 按「多尺度特征列表」契约逐级消费，训练时按各级 featmap_sizes 生成 anchor 网格，衔接下一讲的 3D 锚框生成。
### u5-l4 Anchor3DHead 与 3D 锚框生成

本讲拆解 anchor-based 3D 检测头的三个核心模块（SECOND、PointPillars 等共用）。Anchor3DRangeGenerator 把 ranges（位置）、sizes（尺寸）、rotations（朝向）做笛卡尔积铺满 BEV 网格，anchor 总数＝H×W×尺寸数×朝向数（SECOND KITTI 下为 844800），anchor 的 z 语义是底面中心，Aligned 变体修复格点错位。DeltaXYZWLHRBBoxCoder 规定回归目标：z 先换几何中心再作差、位移按 BEV 对角线与高度归一、尺寸取 log 比，encode/decode 严格互逆，零差值解码回 anchor 自身。Anchor3DHead 仅含分类（A×C）、回归（A×7）、方向（A×2）三个 1×1 卷积分支；FocalLoss 走隐式背景并配 PseudoSampler，回归与方向损失只作用于正样本。角度两大难题分别由正弦差回归（消除 2π 周期）与方向二分类（解决 π 头尾歧义）化解，推理时经 limit_period 折叠加 dir_offset 修正拼回完整 yaw。
### u5-l5 CenterPoint：Anchor-free 的中心点范式

本讲剖析 CenterPoint 的 anchor-free 中心点范式：不预铺海量 anchor、不做 IoU 正负样本分配，而是让每个 BEV 格子预测自己是否为物体中心。CenterPoint 检测器是薄壳，复用 MVXTwoStageDetector 的柱体特征链路（PillarFeatureNet→Scatter→SECOND→SECONDFPN），仅把头换成 CenterHead；头按类别分成 6 个任务子头，每个子头内 SeparateHead 又分 heatmap/reg/height/dim/rot/vel 六个独立分支。训练目标由 get_targets 现场编码：gt 中心画高斯热图（半径随物体尺寸、重叠取 max），并生成 10 维回归目标（亚格子偏移、重心高度、log 尺寸、sin/cos 朝向、速度）；损失为 GaussianFocalLoss 加只在中心格计算的 L1，天然无需 assigner/sampler。推理由 CenterPointBBoxCoder 两级 topK 提取峰值、把格子坐标换算回米制、atan2 还原 yaw，再经 rotate 或 circle NMS 去重，合并六任务并把 z 从重心换回底面中心。
### u5-l6 任务模块：BBox Coder、3D Assigner 与 Sampler

本讲精读 `task_modules` 的训练目标生产线：IoU 计算器算重叠 → Assigner 定身份 → Sampler 挑下标 → BBox Coder 编码回归目标。这些组件无参数、注册于 `TASK_UTILS`，标准调用现场是 `train_mixins` 的 `anchor_target_single_assigner`，返回与 anchor 等长的打表式 8 元组目标。核心结论：`Max3DIoUAssigner` 只重写准备阶段，四步准则继承自 mmdet——IoU 达 `pos_iou_thr` 为正、全部低于 `neg_iou_thr` 为负、其间是忽略带，第 4 步低质量匹配受 `min_pos_iou` 约束保证每个 gt 有正样本；`AssignResult.gt_inds` 以 0 为负、正整数 k 指向第 k−1 个 gt、−1 为忽略；`SamplingResult` 由 pos_inds/neg_inds 派生 pos_gt_bboxes 等（查 gt 需减一）。两种编码哲学对比：`DeltaXYZWLHRBBoxCoder` 回归相对 anchor 的连续偏移并显式换算底面/几何中心；`PartialBinBasedBBoxCoder`（VoteNet 系）把尺寸、朝向拆成 bin 分类加残差，中心取 gravity_center 且 decode 不修正，往返误差恰为 z 列 h/2。FocalLoss 配不采样的 PseudoSampler，`IoUNegPiecewiseSampler` 供两阶段按 IoU 分段抽负样本；VoteNet 以 chamfer 距离匹配替代 assigner。
### u5-l7 3D 损失函数与 NMS

本讲讲解 mmdet3d 三个原生损失与五种 3D 去重后处理。损失均为「无参 nn.Module 壳 + weighted_loss 装饰的裸函数」双层结构，加权与规约由装饰器统一处理，且都属于配对后的对齐 IoU 计算。RotatedIoU3DLoss 处理 7 维旋转框，依赖 mmcv 的 CUDA 可微算子，仅 GPU 可用；AxisAlignedIoULoss 面向室内 6 维对角点框，纯 PyTorch 实现并支持 GIoU 模式；MultiBinLoss 以「bin 分类 + sin/cos 残差回归」化解角度周期性，源码因 return 缩进在循环内而实际只累计第一个 bin。去重方面：box3d_multiclass_nms 逐类调度，按 use_rotate_nms 分派旋转的 nms_bev 与轴对齐的 nms_normal_bev（承接 0.x 旧接口）；aligned_3d_nms 为类别感知的室内体积 NMS；circle_nms 用中心平方距离替代 IoU，阈值需按平方理解。选型直觉：anchor 系用旋转 BEV NMS，室内点云用轴对齐 NMS，CenterPoint 等中心点范式偏爱 circle NMS。
### u6-l1 PointNet++ 系列骨干网络

本讲梳理 PointNet++ 系列点路线骨干：与体素路线（单元 5）相对，不栅格化点云，感受野由米制 radius 显式给出。核心是 SA 模块（Set Abstraction，集合抽象）的采样—分组—聚合三步：FPS 选中心、球查询取邻域、共享 MLP 加邻居维池化，集合运算统一伪装成 (1,1) Conv2d。BasePointNet 固化 (B,N,3+C) 输入契约，特征切分为 (B,C,N) 布局。PointNet2SASSG 是 SA 下采样塔加 FP 上采样（3 近邻距离倒数加权插值）的 U 形骨干，VoteNet 取其末级 1024 个 seed 点供投票；PointNet2SAMSG 无 FP 塔，用多尺度分组、D-FPS/F-FPS/FS 采样、膨胀球壳与聚合压缩，服务 3DSSD/PointRCNN。另介绍变长堆叠、中心点外部给定的 StackedSAModuleMSG（PV-RCNN 关键点分支）与 PointNetFPNeck。骨干输出 dict 而非列表，各级通道可由 skip_channel_list 纸面推导。
### u6-l2 VoteNet：基于投票的室内检测端到端解析

本讲端到端解析室内点云检测器 VoteNet。核心思想是投票（vote）：室内物体只有表面点、几何中心悬空，故让每个表面点（object coordinate）回归指向物体中心（center coordinate）的偏移，票在中心聚簇后再分类回归，且全程采用几何中心口径。前向链路四步：VoteModule 由种子点生成投票点与残差特征；PointSAModule 聚合成提案（训练在投票点上采样、测试在种子点上采样）；BaseConvBboxHead 打分；PartialBinBasedBBoxCoder 解码。VoteNet 无 anchor 与 assigner，提案与真值靠 Chamfer 最近邻匹配，距离小于 0.3 为正、大于 0.6 为负、中间忽略带不计损失；共八项损失，center 损失为双向 Chamfer。推理依次做空框过滤（框内点数大于 5）、aligned_3d_nms 与 per_class_proposal（分数为 objectness 乘语义概率）。检测器为薄壳，重写 loss/predict 仅为把原始点云传入 VoteHead 以生成投票监督。
### u6-l3 更多点云检测器：GroupFree3D、3DSSD、H3DNet

本讲对比三个 VoteNet 之后的进阶点云检测器。GroupFree3D 用 kps 前景打分选候选点，经多层 Transformer 解码器迭代精修出框，取代「投票+分组」范式，逐层深监督。3DSSD 用 F-FPS 特征距离采样保证前景覆盖，投票降为辅助分支，新增 centerness（连续中心度）、corner loss、vote loss 三项监督，推理时 objectness 直接取语义分最大值。H3DNet 为两阶段结构：VoteNet 当 RPN 产提案，RoI 阶段用 z 面、xy 面、line 边三类几何基元匹配提案的 6 面心与 12 边心做残差精修。核心结论：室内检测器不用 IoU assigner，正负样本按「点在框内」或 Chamfer 距离分配；三者共享薄壳检测器加厚 head、gravity_center 口径与 bin-based 编码模板。
### u6-l4 两阶段检测器与 RoI Heads：Part-A2 与 PV-RCNN

本讲剖析两阶段 3D 检测框架：TwoStage3DDetector 把「RPN 出提案、RoI head 精修」串成完整训练与推理链路，train_cfg 按 rpn、rpn_proposal、rcnn 三段注入各组件；roi_heads 子系统由基类骨架、roi_extractors 特征提取器与 bbox_heads 回归头三层组成。Part-A2 用逐体素语义头做前景分割与部位回归，part_feats 经 feats_dict 耦合进 RoI 分支，RoIAwarePool3d 把 RoI 内点重栅格化为 14³ 网格（point→voxel），再由稀疏卷积 bbox head 精修，训练目标为 IoU 软标签、canonical 变换编码与 corner loss 三件套。PV-RCNN 的 VoxelSetAbstraction 以 FPS 关键点做三源特征融合，Batch3DRoIGridExtractor 用 6³ 网格点球查询聚合 RoI 特征。核心结论：Part-A2 池化 RoI 内部的点，PV-RCNN 池化全局关键点，这是二者 RoI 特征来源的本质差异。
### u6-l5 单目 3D 检测：FCOS3D、SMOKE 与相机坐标系

本讲介绍单目 3D 检测：仅凭单张图像输出相机系 3D 框，深度本质不确定，只能靠统计先验与相机内参约束。检测器极薄：SingleStageMono3DDetector 跨库继承 mmdet 一阶段检测器，只补 imgs 取图与 3D/2D 双契约写回，算法集中在 head 与 coder。FCOS3D 走逐像素范式：9 维回归按 group_reg_dims 拆成偏移/深度/尺寸/朝向/速度五组，深度尺寸用 exp（或先验线性）解码，全局朝向=视线角+局部朝向；SMOKE 走热图范式：局部极大值检出免 NMS，经 trans_mat 与内参逆解析反投影，训练用角点 L1 损失。数据契约新增 centers_2d 与 depths，管线与解码器配套设计。
### u6-l6 多模态融合检测：MVXNet 与 mmdet 组件复用

本讲以 MVXNet 剖析多模态融合与 mmdet 组件复用。MVXTwoStageDetector 用 pts_*/img_* 可选槽位积木式装配双分支；动态体素化下 voxels 即原始点，聚合推迟到网络内 DynamicScatter，故 DynamicMVXFasterRCNN 重写 extract_pts_feat。核心结论：点级融合插在 DynamicVFE 末层——PointFusion 将点经「逆 3D 增强（按 transformation_3d_flow 倒序重放）→ lidar2img 投影 → 正向 2D 增强 → grid_sample」三重坐标变换采得图像特征，与点特征相加后随点聚合进体素；两分支唯一汇合点是 extract_feat 把 img_feats 传入点云分支。配置仅借用 mmdet 五处（ResNet、FPN 及三个损失函数），未配 2D 检测头，图像分支是纯「特征捐赠者」，3D 损失全来自 Anchor3DHead。关键术语：点级融合、动态体素化、lidar2img、特征捐赠者——其中点级融合区别于 BEVFusion 的 BEV 级融合，为后续对照埋线。
### u7-l1 train.py 与 Runner 训练全流程

本讲剖析 mmdet3d 的训练全流程。核心结论：tools/train.py 是「薄入口」，不含训练逻辑，只做解析参数、Config.fromfile 合并配置、按 CLI 改写配置（--amp 换用 AmpOptimWrapper 开混合精度、--resume 自动找最新断点续训并覆盖 load_from、--cfg-options 深度合并），再把配置交给 Runner.from_cfg 组装模型、dataloader、优化器包装器与 hook 等组件，启动 runner.train() 主循环。日程基座 cyclic-40e 用两段余弦 param_scheduler 让学习率与动量反向变化并逐 iter 连续生效，梯度裁剪是 OptimWrapper 的职责，RepeatDataset 使真实数据轮数等于 max_epochs 乘 times。运行时基座 default_runtime 提供六个默认 hook（计时、日志、推进调度器、存档、分布式种子、3D 可视化）与窗口平滑的 LogProcessor。主循环每 iter 依次执行 hook 计时、model.train_step（内含 data_preprocessor 与 loss 计算）、推进 lr 并记日志，每隔 val_interval 轮跑 ValLoop 输出 mAP。work_dir 产出日志、vis_data/scalars.json 与 checkpoint；日志中 time 与 data_time 之比是判断数据瓶颈还是算力瓶颈的第一依据。
### u7-l2 test.py 与评估指标体系

本讲讲解 tools/test.py 测试入口与 mmdet3d 评估指标体系。test.py 是薄入口，只按命令行改写配置（checkpoint、work_dir、可视化、TTA）后交给 runner.test()；关键辨析：命令行 --score-thr 只进可视化 hook，而 model.test_cfg.score_thr 在 box3d_multiclass_nms 前过滤预测，才真正影响 mAP。8 个 metric 类均继承 BaseMetric 两段式契约：process 逐批把预测攒为 CPU 结果、compute_metrics 全量结算，因 AP 需全数据集统一排序；format_only 可只转官方提交格式。NuScenesMetric 走官方 devkit 路线，按 BEV 中心距离（0.5/1/2/4 米）匹配，输出 mAP、五类 TP 误差（mATE/mASE/mAOE/mAVE/mAAE）与 NDS，LiDAR 模型属性由速度启发式兜底。KittiMetric 为自研 numba 实现：预测与真值均转回 KITTI 原生九字段，按图像高度、遮挡、截断分 easy/moderate/hard 三档，strict/loose 双 IoU 阈值，41 点 PR 单调化得 AP11/AP40，纯 LiDAR 的 2D AP 来自 3D 框投影。其余 Waymo 调官方 C++ 二进制、Lyft 走 devkit、室内指标复用 indoor_eval（3D IoU@0.25/0.5）。
### u7-l3 可视化系统：Det3DLocalVisualizer 与 Hook

本讲剖析 mmdet3d 可视化系统：Det3DLocalVisualizer 经 mmengine→mmdet→mmdet3d 三层继承复用 2D 绘制能力，是按名字索引的全局单例；vis_backends（Local/Tensorboard）将绘制与存储解耦，一张图可多后端落盘。add_datasample 为唯一总入口，按 vis_task 五选一分流：点云通道统一转 DEPTH 坐标系交给 Open3D，图像通道用 matplotlib 画投影框。3D 框颜色唯一来源是数据集 METAINFO 的 palette 经 get_palette 扩展、按 labels_3d 逐框查表，与置信度无关；直接调绘制原语不会自动上色。三种绘制原语的数学：Open3D 框需底面中心换几何中心，BEV 框由 bev 属性（XYWHR）加两组正交半向量算四角，图像投影走齐次坐标除深度，深度系投影前先逆放数据增强。Det3DVisualizationHook 默认 draw=False，由 test.py 的 --show/--show-dir 改写配置打开：验证按 interval 抽帧，测试逐条落盘到 work_dir/时间戳/指定目录，数据一律从 img_path、lidar_path 重读原始文件；CLI 的 --score-thr 即 Hook 的 score_thr，只影响画哪些框，不影响 mAP。
### u7-l4 高阶推理：Inferencer 体系与 TTA

本讲讲解 mmdet3d 的一站式推理封装与测试时增强（TTA）。`Base3DInferencer` 仅凭 config+checkpoint 装配推理服务：SyncBN 降级、摘除 train_cfg、建模型载权重、恢复 dataset_meta（类别与调色板），主循环按 preprocess→forward→visualize→postprocess 推进，参数经 kwargs 白名单路由；LiDAR/单目/多模态/分割四个子类仅对测试管线做外科手术（替换加载器、注入 info pkl 标定、删真值 transform）。检测 TTA 由 `MultiScaleFlipAug3D` 枚举视图并预写 flip/pcd_scale_factor 决策键（几何变换仍由 RandomFlip3D 等执行），`aug_test` 逐视图推理后 `merge_aug_bboxes_3d` 经 `bbox3d_mapping_back` 逆序还原（先翻转再除尺度，旋转平移不可还原）、拼接并逐类 BEV NMS 去重；配置上检测类直接覆写 test_pipeline，分割类用 tta_pipeline+Seg3DTTAModel（softmax 平均）经 test.py --tta 启用。mmcv `TestTimeAug` 为通用笛卡尔积 TTA，`MultiViewWrapper` 系多相机决策复用，与 TTA 无关。
### u7-l5 实用工具集：分析、浏览与模型转换

本讲介绍 mmdetection3d 的五组实用工具：analyze_logs.py 解析 JSON-lines 训练日志，凭键名是否含斜杠区分训练曲线与验证指标，可画 loss/mAP 曲线并统计每 iter 耗时（默认剔除每 epoch 首个离群值）；get_flops.py 估算 FLOPs 与参数量，核心结论是参数量与输入无关、FLOPs 随输入尺寸变化，且哑输入绕过 data_preprocessor，对体素类模型仅属实验性估算；benchmark.py 以真实测试数据经 model.test_step 端到端测 fps，关键概念为 warmup 与 CUDA 同步计时，并指出缺 type=int 等源码瑕疵；browse_dataset.py 可视化管线输出，核查标注与增强正确性；收尾工具含 fuse_conv_bn（Conv+BN 融合加速）、publish_model（去 optimizer、加哈希）等，visualize_results.py 被辨析为 0.x 遗留脚本。总原则：工具用法以脚本 --help 为准，读源码可识破文档漂移。

# Copyright (c) OpenMMLab. All rights reserved.
from os import path as osp
from typing import Callable, List, Optional, Sequence, Union

import numpy as np
from mmengine.dataset import BaseDataset
from mmengine.fileio import get_local_path

from mmdet3d.registry import DATASETS


@DATASETS.register_module()
class Seg3DDataset(BaseDataset):
    """Base Class for 3D semantic segmentation dataset.

    This is the base dataset of ScanNet, S3DIS and SemanticKITTI dataset.

    Args:
        data_root (str, optional): Path of dataset root. Defaults to None.
        ann_file (str): Path of annotation file. Defaults to ''.
        metainfo (dict, optional): Meta information for dataset, such as class
            information. Defaults to None.
        data_prefix (dict): Prefix for training data. Defaults to
            dict(pts='points',
                 img='',
                 pts_instance_mask='',
                 pts_semantic_mask='').
        pipeline (List[dict]): Pipeline used for data processing.
            Defaults to [].
        modality (dict): Modality to specify the sensor data used
            as input, it usually has following keys:

                - use_camera: bool
                - use_lidar: bool
            Defaults to dict(use_lidar=True, use_camera=False).
        ignore_index (int, optional): The label index to be ignored, e.g.
            unannotated points. If None is given, set to len(self.classes) to
            be consistent with PointSegClassMapping function in pipeline.
            Defaults to None.
        scene_idxs (np.ndarray or str, optional): Precomputed index to load
            data. For scenes with many points, we may sample it several times.
            Defaults to None.
        test_mode (bool): Whether the dataset is in test mode.
            Defaults to False.
        serialize_data (bool): Whether to hold memory using serialized objects,
            when enabled, data loader workers can use shared RAM from master
            process instead of making a copy.
            Defaults to False for 3D Segmentation datasets.
        load_eval_anns (bool): Whether to load annotations in test_mode,
            the annotation will be save in `eval_ann_infos`, which can be used
            in Evaluator. Defaults to True.
        backend_args (dict, optional): Arguments to instantiate the
            corresponding backend. Defaults to None.
    """
    METAINFO = {
        'classes': None,  # names of all classes data used for the task
        'palette': None,  # official color for visualization
        'seg_valid_class_ids': None,  # class_ids used for training
        'seg_all_class_ids': None,  # all possible class_ids in loaded seg mask
    }

    def __init__(self,
                 data_root: Optional[str] = None,
                 ann_file: str = '',
                 metainfo: Optional[dict] = None,
                 data_prefix: dict = dict(
                     pts='points',
                     img='',
                     pts_instance_mask='',
                     pts_semantic_mask=''),
                 pipeline: List[Union[dict, Callable]] = [],
                 modality: dict = dict(use_lidar=True, use_camera=False),
                 ignore_index: Optional[int] = None,
                 scene_idxs: Optional[Union[str, np.ndarray]] = None,
                 test_mode: bool = False,
                 serialize_data: bool = False,
                 load_eval_anns: bool = True,
                 backend_args: Optional[dict] = None,
                 **kwargs) -> None:
        self.backend_args = backend_args
        self.modality = modality
        self.load_eval_anns = load_eval_anns

        # TODO: We maintain the ignore_index attributes,
        # but we may consider to remove it in the future.
        self.ignore_index = len(self.METAINFO['classes']) if \
            ignore_index is None else ignore_index

        # Get label mapping for custom classes
        new_classes = metainfo.get('classes', None)

        self.label_mapping, self.label2cat, seg_valid_class_ids = \
            self.get_label_mapping(new_classes)

        metainfo['label_mapping'] = self.label_mapping
        metainfo['label2cat'] = self.label2cat
        metainfo['ignore_index'] = self.ignore_index
        metainfo['seg_valid_class_ids'] = seg_valid_class_ids

        # generate palette if it is not defined based on
        # label mapping, otherwise directly use palette
        # defined in dataset config.
        palette = metainfo.get('palette', None)
        updated_palette = self._update_palette(new_classes, palette)

        metainfo['palette'] = updated_palette

        # construct seg_label_mapping for semantic mask
        self.seg_label_mapping = self.get_seg_label_mapping(metainfo)

        super().__init__(
            ann_file=ann_file,
            metainfo=metainfo,
            data_root=data_root,
            data_prefix=data_prefix,
            pipeline=pipeline,
            test_mode=test_mode,
            serialize_data=serialize_data,
            **kwargs)

        self.metainfo['seg_label_mapping'] = self.seg_label_mapping
        if not kwargs.get('lazy_init', False):
            self.scene_idxs = self.get_scene_idxs(scene_idxs)
            self.data_list = [self.data_list[i] for i in self.scene_idxs]

            # set group flag for the sampler
            if not self.test_mode:
                self._set_group_flag()

    def get_label_mapping(self,
                          new_classes: Optional[Sequence] = None) -> tuple:
        """Get label mapping.

        The ``label_mapping`` is a dictionary, its keys are the old label ids
        and its values are the new label ids, and is used for changing pixel
        labels in load_annotations. If and only if old classes in cls.METAINFO
        is not equal to new classes in self._metainfo and nether of them is not
        None, `label_mapping` is not None.

        Args:
            new_classes (list or tuple, optional): The new classes name from
                metainfo. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            tuple: The mapping from old classes in cls.METAINFO to
            new classes in metainfo
        """
        old_classes = self.METAINFO.get('classes', None)
        if (new_classes is not None and old_classes is not None
                and list(new_classes) != list(old_classes)):
            if not set(new_classes).issubset(old_classes):
                raise ValueError(
                    f'new classes {new_classes} is not a '
                    f'subset of classes {old_classes} in METAINFO.')

            # obtain true id from valid_class_ids
            valid_class_ids = [
                self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids'][old_classes.index(
                    cls_name)] for cls_name in new_classes
            ]
            label_mapping = {
                cls_id: self.ignore_index
                for cls_id in self.METAINFO['seg_all_class_ids']
            }
            label_mapping.update(
                {cls_id: i
                 for i, cls_id in enumerate(valid_class_ids)})
            label2cat = {i: cat_name for i, cat_name in enumerate(new_classes)}
        else:
            label_mapping = {
                cls_id: self.ignore_index
                for cls_id in self.METAINFO['seg_all_class_ids']
            }
            label_mapping.update({
                cls_id: i
                for i, cls_id in enumerate(
                    self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids'])
            })
            # map label to category name
            label2cat = {
                i: cat_name
                for i, cat_name in enumerate(self.METAINFO['classes'])
            }
            valid_class_ids = self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids']

        return label_mapping, label2cat, valid_class_ids

    def get_seg_label_mapping(self, metainfo=None):
        """Get segmentation label mapping.

        The ``seg_label_mapping`` is an array, its indices are the old label
        ids and its values are the new label ids, and is specifically used
        for changing point labels in PointSegClassMapping.

        Args:
            metainfo (dict, optional): Meta information to set
            seg_label_mapping. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            tuple: The mapping from old classes to new classes.
        """
        seg_max_cat_id = len(self.METAINFO['seg_all_class_ids'])
        seg_valid_cat_ids = self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids']
        neg_label = len(seg_valid_cat_ids)
        seg_label_mapping = np.ones(
            seg_max_cat_id + 1, dtype=np.int64) * neg_label
        for cls_idx, cat_id in enumerate(seg_valid_cat_ids):
            seg_label_mapping[cat_id] = cls_idx
        return seg_label_mapping

    def _update_palette(self, new_classes: list, palette: Union[None,
                                                                list]) -> list:
        """Update palette according to metainfo.

        If length of palette is equal to classes, just return the palette.
        If palette is not defined, it will randomly generate a palette.
        If classes is updated by customer, it will return the subset of
        palette.

        Returns:
            Sequence: Palette for current dataset.
        """
        if palette is None:
            # If palette is not defined, it generate a palette according
            # to the original palette and classes.
            old_classes = self.METAINFO.get('classes', None)
            palette = [
                self.METAINFO['palette'][old_classes.index(cls_name)]
                for cls_name in new_classes
            ]
            return palette

        # palette does match classes
        if len(palette) == len(new_classes):
            return palette
        else:
            raise ValueError('Once palette in set in metainfo, it should'
                             'match classes in metainfo')

    def parse_data_info(self, info: dict) -> dict:
        """Process the raw data info.

        Convert all relative path of needed modality data file to
        the absolute path. And process
        the `instances` field to `ann_info` in training stage.

        Args:
            info (dict): Raw info dict.

        Returns:
            dict: Has `ann_info` in training stage. And
            all path has been converted to absolute path.
        """
        if self.modality['use_lidar']:
            info['lidar_points']['lidar_path'] = \
                osp.join(
                    self.data_prefix.get('pts', ''),
                    info['lidar_points']['lidar_path'])
            if 'num_pts_feats' in info['lidar_points']:
                info['num_pts_feats'] = info['lidar_points']['num_pts_feats']
            info['lidar_path'] = info['lidar_points']['lidar_path']

        if self.modality['use_camera']:
            for cam_id, img_info in info['images'].items():
                if 'img_path' in img_info:
                    img_info['img_path'] = osp.join(
                        self.data_prefix.get('img', ''), img_info['img_path'])

        if 'pts_instance_mask_path' in info:
            info['pts_instance_mask_path'] = \
                osp.join(self.data_prefix.get('pts_instance_mask', ''),
                         info['pts_instance_mask_path'])

        if 'pts_semantic_mask_path' in info:
            info['pts_semantic_mask_path'] = \
                osp.join(self.data_prefix.get('pts_semantic_mask', ''),
                         info['pts_semantic_mask_path'])

        # only be used in `PointSegClassMapping` in pipeline
        # to map original semantic class to valid category ids.
        info['seg_label_mapping'] = self.seg_label_mapping

        # 'eval_ann_info' will be updated in loading transforms
        if self.test_mode and self.load_eval_anns:
            info['eval_ann_info'] = dict()

        return info

    def prepare_data(self, idx: int) -> dict:
        """Get data processed by ``self.pipeline``.

        Args:
            idx (int): The index of ``data_info``.

        Returns:
            dict: Results passed through ``self.pipeline``.
        """
        if not self.test_mode:
            data_info = self.get_data_info(idx)
            # Pass the dataset to the pipeline during training to support mixed
            # data augmentation, such as polarmix and lasermix.
            data_info['dataset'] = self
            return self.pipeline(data_info)
        else:
            return super().prepare_data(idx)

    def get_scene_idxs(self, scene_idxs: Union[None, str,
                                               np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
        """Compute scene_idxs for data sampling.

        We sample more times for scenes with more points.
        """
        if self.test_mode:
            # when testing, we load one whole scene every time
            return np.arange(len(self)).astype(np.int32)

        # we may need to re-sample different scenes according to scene_idxs
        # this is necessary for indoor scene segmentation such as ScanNet
        if scene_idxs is None:
            scene_idxs = np.arange(len(self))
        if isinstance(scene_idxs, str):
            scene_idxs = osp.join(self.data_root, scene_idxs)
            with get_local_path(
                    scene_idxs, backend_args=self.backend_args) as local_path:
                scene_idxs = np.load(local_path)
        else:
            scene_idxs = np.array(scene_idxs)

        return scene_idxs.astype(np.int32)

    def _set_group_flag(self) -> None:
        """Set flag according to image aspect ratio.

        Images with aspect ratio greater than 1 will be set as group 1,
        otherwise group 0. In 3D datasets, they are all the same, thus are all
        zeros.
        """
        self.flag = np.zeros(len(self), dtype=np.uint8)

from typing import Dict

from torch import Tensor

from mmdet3d.registry import MODELS
from mmdet3d.utils import ConfigType, OptConfigType, OptMultiConfig
from ...structures.det3d_data_sample import SampleList
from .encoder_decoder import EncoderDecoder3D


@MODELS.register_module()
class Cylinder3D(EncoderDecoder3D):
    """`Cylindrical and Asymmetrical 3D Convolution Networks for LiDAR
    Segmentation.

        <https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.10033>`_.

    Args:
        voxel_encoder (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`): The config for the
            points2voxel encoder of segmentor.
        backbone (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`): The config for the backnone of
            segmentor.
        decode_head (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`): The config for the decode
            head of segmentor.
        neck (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The config for the neck of
            segmentor. Defaults to None.
        auxiliary_head (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict` or List[dict or
            :obj:`ConfigDict`], optional): The config for the auxiliary head of
            segmentor. Defaults to None.
        loss_regularization (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict` or List[dict or
            :obj:`ConfigDict`], optional): The config for the regularization
            loass. Defaults to None.
        train_cfg (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The config for
            training. Defaults to None.
        test_cfg (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The config for testing.
            Defaults to None.
        data_preprocessor (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The
            pre-process config of :class:`BaseDataPreprocessor`.
            Defaults to None.
        init_cfg (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict` or List[dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`],
            optional): The weight initialized config for :class:`BaseModule`.
            Defaults to None.
    """

    def __init__(self,
                 voxel_encoder: ConfigType,
                 backbone: ConfigType,
                 decode_head: ConfigType,
                 neck: OptConfigType = None,
                 auxiliary_head: OptConfigType = None,
                 loss_regularization: OptConfigType = None,
                 train_cfg: OptConfigType = None,
                 test_cfg: OptConfigType = None,
                 data_preprocessor: OptConfigType = None,
                 init_cfg: OptMultiConfig = None) -> None:
        super(Cylinder3D, self).__init__(
            backbone=backbone,
            decode_head=decode_head,
            neck=neck,
            auxiliary_head=auxiliary_head,
            loss_regularization=loss_regularization,
            train_cfg=train_cfg,
            test_cfg=test_cfg,
            data_preprocessor=data_preprocessor,
            init_cfg=init_cfg)

        self.voxel_encoder = MODELS.build(voxel_encoder)

    def extract_feat(self, batch_inputs: dict) -> Tensor:
        """Extract features from points."""
        encoded_feats = self.voxel_encoder(batch_inputs['voxels']['voxels'],
                                           batch_inputs['voxels']['coors'])
        batch_inputs['voxels']['voxel_coors'] = encoded_feats[1]
        x = self.backbone(encoded_feats[0], encoded_feats[1],
                          len(batch_inputs['points']))
        if self.with_neck:
            x = self.neck(x)
        return x

    def loss(self, batch_inputs_dict: dict,
             batch_data_samples: SampleList) -> Dict[str, Tensor]:
        """Calculate losses from a batch of inputs and data samples.

        Args:
            batch_inputs_dict (dict): Input sample dict which
                includes 'points' and 'imgs' keys.

                - points (List[Tensor]): Point cloud of each sample.
                - imgs (Tensor, optional): Image tensor has shape (B, C, H, W).
            batch_data_samples (List[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]): The det3d data
                samples. It usually includes information such as `metainfo` and
                `gt_pts_seg`.

        Returns:
            Dict[str, Tensor]: A dictionary of loss components.
        """

        # extract features using backbone
        x = self.extract_feat(batch_inputs_dict)
        losses = dict()
        loss_decode = self._decode_head_forward_train(x, batch_data_samples)
        losses.update(loss_decode)

        return losses

    def predict(self,
                batch_inputs_dict: dict,
                batch_data_samples: SampleList,
                rescale: bool = True) -> SampleList:
        """Simple test with single scene.

        Args:
            batch_inputs_dict (dict): Input sample dict which includes 'points'
                and 'imgs' keys.

                - points (List[Tensor]): Point cloud of each sample.
                - imgs (Tensor, optional): Image tensor has shape (B, C, H, W).
            batch_data_samples (List[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]): The det3d data
                samples. It usually includes information such as `metainfo` and
                `gt_pts_seg`.
            rescale (bool): Whether transform to original number of points.
                Will be used for voxelization based segmentors.
                Defaults to True.

        Returns:
            List[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]: Segmentation results of the input
            points. Each Det3DDataSample usually contains:

            - ``pred_pts_seg`` (PointData): Prediction of 3D semantic
              segmentation.
            - ``pts_seg_logits`` (PointData): Predicted logits of 3D semantic
              segmentation before normalization.
        """
        # 3D segmentation requires per-point prediction, so it's impossible
        # to use down-sampling to get a batch of scenes with same num_points
        # therefore, we only support testing one scene every time
        x = self.extract_feat(batch_inputs_dict)
        seg_logits_list = self.decode_head.predict(x, batch_inputs_dict,
                                                   batch_data_samples)
        for i in range(len(seg_logits_list)):
            seg_logits_list[i] = seg_logits_list[i].transpose(0, 1)

        return self.postprocess_result(seg_logits_list, batch_data_samples)

# Copyright (c) OpenMMLab. All rights reserved.
import logging
import os
from argparse import ArgumentParser

from mmengine.logging import print_log

from mmdet3d.apis import LidarSeg3DInferencer


def parse_args():
    parser = ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('pcd', help='Point cloud file')
    parser.add_argument('model', help='Config file')
    parser.add_argument('weights', help='Checkpoint file')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--device', default='cuda:0', help='Device used for inference')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--out-dir',
        type=str,
        default='outputs',
        help='Output directory of prediction and visualization results.')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--show',
        action='store_true',
        help='Show online visualization results')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--wait-time',
        type=float,
        default=-1,
        help='The interval of show (s). Demo will be blocked in showing'
        'results, if wait_time is -1. Defaults to -1.')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--no-save-vis',
        action='store_true',
        help='Do not save detection visualization results')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--no-save-pred',
        action='store_true',
        help='Do not save detection prediction results')
    parser.add_argument(
        '--print-result',
        action='store_true',
        help='Whether to print the results.')
    call_args = vars(parser.parse_args())

    call_args['inputs'] = dict(points=call_args.pop('pcd'))

    if call_args['no_save_vis'] and call_args['no_save_pred']:
        call_args['out_dir'] = ''

    init_kws = ['model', 'weights', 'device']
    init_args = {}
    for init_kw in init_kws:
        init_args[init_kw] = call_args.pop(init_kw)

    # NOTE: If your operating environment does not have a display device,
    # (e.g. a remote server), you can save the predictions and visualize
    # them in local devices.
    if os.environ.get('DISPLAY') is None and call_args['show']:
        print_log(
            'Display device not found. `--show` is forced to False',
            logger='current',
            level=logging.WARNING)
        call_args['show'] = False

    return init_args, call_args


def main():
    # TODO: Support inference of point cloud numpy file.
    init_args, call_args = parse_args()

    inferencer = LidarSeg3DInferencer(**init_args)
    inferencer(**call_args)

    if call_args['out_dir'] != '' and not (call_args['no_save_vis']
                                           and call_args['no_save_pred']):
        print_log(
            f'results have been saved at {call_args["out_dir"]}',
            logger='current')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

## update 模式规则

当 action 为 `update` 时：

1. 先 `Read` 当前已有的讲义文件。
2. 使用 `git diff previous_head..current_head` 查看相关代码变化。
3. 更新已经失效的源码说明。
4. 刷新所有永久链接中的 head 和行号。
5. 保留仍然正确的内容。
6. 新增必要解释和实践步骤。
7. 如果核心流程已经变化，可以重写受影响章节。

---

## 讲义标准结构

每篇讲义必须使用下面的结构。

```md
# 讲义标题

## 1. 本讲目标

说明读者学完后应该掌握什么。

## 2. 前置知识

用通俗语言解释本讲需要的基础概念。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

列出本讲涉及的关键文件，并说明每个文件的作用。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

按最小模块拆分。

每个最小模块都必须包含：

### 4.x 模块名称

#### 4.x.1 概念说明

解释这个模块是什么、解决什么问题、为什么需要它。

#### 4.x.2 核心流程

用列表、流程图式文字或伪代码描述执行过程。

如涉及算法、协议、并发、缓存、调度、状态机等，可以补充必要数学或原理说明。

数学公式使用：

- 行内：\( ... \)
- 独立公式：\[ ... \]

不要使用 `$...$`。

#### 4.x.3 源码精读

引用真实项目代码。

每个关键代码点都要给出永久链接，格式为：

[文件路径:L起始-L结束](<permalink_base>/<相对路径>#L起始-L结束)

链接旁边必须用中文说明这段代码做了什么。

#### 4.x.4 代码实践

给出一个可操作的小实践，例如：

- 运行一个示例。
- 阅读一个测试。
- 修改一个配置。
- 添加一行日志。
- 改一个参数观察行为。
- 编写一个最小调用示例。
- 跟踪一条调用链。

实践步骤要包含：

1. 实践目标。
2. 操作步骤。
3. 需要观察的现象。
4. 预期结果。
5. 如果无法确定运行结果，明确写「待本地验证」。

不要假装已经运行过命令。

#### 4.x.5 小练习与答案

给出 2 到 3 个练习题，并直接给出参考答案。
```

---

## 讲义结尾必须包含

```md
## 5. 综合实践

设计一个贯穿本讲主要内容的小任务，帮助读者把知识串起来。

## 6. 本讲小结

用 3 到 6 条 bullet 总结本讲。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

说明下一讲应该学习什么，或者建议读者继续阅读哪些源码。
```

---

## 代码实践要求

每篇讲义至少包含一个完整代码实践。

实践优先从以下位置寻找依据：

- README
- examples
- tests
- scripts
- package scripts
- Makefile
- CI 配置
- 项目已有 demo

如果找不到可运行示例，也必须提供「源码阅读型实践」，例如：

- 跟踪函数调用链。
- 根据测试断言理解行为。
- 修改局部参数并说明应该观察什么。
- 给关键函数添加日志。
- 阅读配置加载过程并画出流程。

---

## 源码引用要求

- 只引用实际存在的文件。
- 行号必须准确。
- 永久链接必须使用当前 HEAD。
- 如果无法确认行号，不要编造，标注「待确认」。
- 示例代码如果不是项目原有代码，必须明确标注为「示例代码」。

---

## 写作风格

- 中文。
- 深入浅出。
- 先讲直觉，再讲源码。
- 多使用标题、列表、表格和伪代码。
- 不要写空泛总结。
- 不要堆砌大段源码。
- 代码片段要短，只保留关键部分。
- 对初学者不熟悉的术语要解释。

---

## 输出与写入规则

- 只写 stdin 指定的文件。
- 文件路径必须是 `<项目名>-tutorial/<filename>`。
- 不要写其他文件。
- 不要修改源码。
- 完成后，用一句话总结本讲义覆盖了哪些最小模块。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

60	    }

132	        """Get label mapping.

135	        and its values are the new label ids, and is used for changing pixel

164	            }
165	            label_mapping.update(
166	                {cls_id: i
167	                 for i, cls_id in enumerate(valid_class_ids)})
168	            label2cat = {i: cat_name for i, cat_name in enumerate(new_classes)}
169	        else:
170	            label_mapping = {
171	                cls_id: self.ignore_index
172	                for cls_id in self.METAINFO['seg_all_class_ids']
173	            }
174	            label_mapping.update({
175	                cls_id: i
176	                for i, cls_id in enumerate(
177	                    self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids'])
178	            })
179	            # map label to category name
180	            label2cat = {
181	                i: cat_name
182	                for i, cat_name in enumerate(self.METAINFO['classes'])
183	            }
184	            valid_class_ids = self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids']
185	
186	        return label_mapping, label2cat, valid_class_ids
187	
188	    def get_seg_label_mapping(self, metainfo=None):
189	        """Get segmentation label mapping.
190	
191	        The ``seg_label_mapping`` is an array, its indices are the old label
192	        ids and its values are the new label ids, and is specifically used
193	        for changing point labels in PointSegClassMapping.
194	
195	        Args:
196	            metainfo (dict, optional): Meta information to set
197	            seg_label_mapping. Defaults to None.
198	
199	        Returns:
200	            tuple: The mapping from old classes to new classes.
201	        """
202	        seg_max_cat_id = len(self.METAINFO['seg_all_class_ids'])
203	        seg_valid_cat_ids = self.METAINFO['seg_valid_class_ids']
204	        neg_label = len(seg_valid_cat_ids)
205	        seg_label_mapping = np.ones(
206	            seg_max_cat_id + 1, dtype=np.int64) * neg_label
207	        for cls_idx, cat_id in enumerate(seg_valid_cat_ids):
208	            seg_label_mapping[cat_id] = cls_idx
209	        return seg_label_mapping
210	
211	    def _update_palette(self, new_classes: list, palette: Union[None,
212	                                                                list]) -> list:
213	        """Update palette according to metainfo.
214	
215	        If length of palette is equal to classes, just return the palette.
216	        If palette is not defined, it will randomly generate a palette.
217	        If classes is updated by customer, it will return the subset of
218	        palette.
219	
220	        Returns:
221	            Sequence: Palette for current dataset.
222	        """
223	        if palette is None:
224	            # If palette is not defined, it generate a palette according
225	            # to the original palette and classes.
226	            old_classes = self.METAINFO.get('classes', None)
227	            palette = [
228	                self.METAINFO['palette'][old_classes.index(cls_name)]
229	                for cls_name in new_classes
230	            ]
231	            return palette
232	
233	        # palette does match classes
234	        if len(palette) == len(new_classes):
235	            return palette
236	        else:
237	            raise ValueError('Once palette in set in metainfo, it should'
238	                             'match classes in metainfo')
239	
240	    def parse_data_info(self, info: dict) -> dict:
241	        """Process the raw data info.
242	
243	        Convert all relative path of needed modality data file to
244	        the absolute path. And process
245	        the `instances` field to `ann_info` in training stage.
246	
247	        Args:
248	            info (dict): Raw info dict.
249	
250	        Returns:
251	            dict: Has `ann_info` in training stage. And
252	            all path has been converted to absolute path.
253	        """
254	        if self.modality['use_lidar']:
255	            info['lidar_points']['lidar_path'] = \
256	                osp.join(
257	                    self.data_prefix.get('pts', ''),
258	                    info['lidar_points']['lidar_path'])
259	            if 'num_pts_feats' in info['lidar_points']:
260	                info['num_pts_feats'] = info['lidar_points']['num_pts_feats']
261	            info['lidar_path'] = info['lidar_points']['lidar_path']
262	
263	        if self.modality['use_camera']:
264	            for cam_id, img_info in info['images'].items():
265	                if 'img_path' in img_info:
266	                    img_info['img_path'] = osp.join(
267	                        self.data_prefix.get('img', ''), img_info['img_path'])
268	
269	        if 'pts_instance_mask_path' in info:
270	            info['pts_instance_mask_path'] = \
271	                osp.join(self.data_prefix.get('pts_instance_mask', ''),
272	                         info['pts_instance_mask_path'])
273	
274	        if 'pts_semantic_mask_path' in info:
275	            info['pts_semantic_mask_path'] = \
276	                osp.join(self.data_prefix.get('pts_semantic_mask', ''),
277	                         info['pts_semantic_mask_path'])
278	
279	        # only be used in `PointSegClassMapping` in pipeline
280	        # to map original semantic class to valid category ids.
281	        info['seg_label_mapping'] = self.seg_label_mapping
282	
283	        # 'eval_ann_info' will be updated in loading transforms
284	        if self.test_mode and self.load_eval_anns:
285	            info['eval_ann_info'] = dict()
286	
287	        return info
288	
289	    def prepare_data(self, idx: int) -> dict:
290	        """Get data processed by ``self.pipeline``.
291	
292	        Args:
293	            idx (int): The index of ``data_info``.
294	
295	        Returns:
296	            dict: Results passed through ``self.pipeline``.
297	        """
298	        if not self.test_mode:
299	            data_info = self.get_data_info(idx)
300	            # Pass the dataset to the pipeline during training to support mixed
301	            # data augmentation, such as polarmix and lasermix.
302	            data_info['dataset'] = self
303	            return self.pipeline(data_info)
304	        else:
305	            return super().prepare_data(idx)
306	
307	    def get_scene_idxs(self, scene_idxs: Union[None, str,
308	                                               np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
309	        """Compute scene_idxs for data sampling.
310	
311	        We sample more times for scenes with more points.
312	        """
313	        if self.test_mode:
314	            # when testing, we load one whole scene every time
315	            return np.arange(len(self)).astype(np.int32)
316	
317	        # we may need to re-sample different scenes according to scene_idxs
318	        # this is necessary for indoor scene segmentation such as ScanNet
319	        if scene_idxs is None:
320	            scene_idxs = np.arange(len(self))
321	        if isinstance(scene_idxs, str):
322	            scene_idxs = osp.join(self.data_root, scene_idxs)
323	            with get_local_path(
324	                    scene_idxs, backend_args=self.backend_args) as local_path:
325	                scene_idxs = np.load(local_path)
326	        else:
327	            scene_idxs = np.array(scene_idxs)
328	
329	        return scene_idxs.astype(np.int32)
330	
331	    def _set_group_flag(self) -> None:
332	        """Set flag according to image aspect ratio.
333	
334	        Images with aspect ratio greater than 1 will be set as group 1,
335	        otherwise group 0. In 3D datasets, they are all the same, thus are all
336	        zeros.
337	        """
338	        self.flag = np.zeros(len(self), dtype=np.uint8)

2	from typing import Dict
3	
4	from torch import Tensor
5	
6	from mmdet3d.registry import MODELS
7	from mmdet3d.utils import ConfigType, OptConfigType, OptMultiConfig
8	from ...structures.det3d_data_sample import SampleList

12	@MODELS.register_module()
13	class Cylinder3D(EncoderDecoder3D):
14	    """`Cylindrical and Asymmetrical 3D Convolution Networks for LiDAR
15	    Segmentation.
16	
17	        <https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.10033>`_.
18	
19	    Args:
20	        voxel_encoder (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`): The config for the
21	            points2voxel encoder of segmentor.
22	        backbone (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`): The config for the backnone of
23	            segmentor.
24	        decode_head (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`): The config for the decode
25	            head of segmentor.
26	        neck (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The config for the neck of
27	            segmentor. Defaults to None.
28	        auxiliary_head (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict` or List[dict or
29	            :obj:`ConfigDict`], optional): The config for the auxiliary head of
30	            segmentor. Defaults to None.
31	        loss_regularization (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict` or List[dict or
32	            :obj:`ConfigDict`], optional): The config for the regularization
33	            loass. Defaults to None.
34	        train_cfg (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The config for
35	            training. Defaults to None.
36	        test_cfg (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The config for testing.
37	            Defaults to None.
38	        data_preprocessor (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`, optional): The
39	            pre-process config of :class:`BaseDataPreprocessor`.
40	            Defaults to None.
41	        init_cfg (dict or :obj:`ConfigDict` or List[dict or :obj:`ConfigDict`],
42	            optional): The weight initialized config for :class:`BaseModule`.
43	            Defaults to None.
44	    """
45	
46	    def __init__(self,
47	                 voxel_encoder: ConfigType,
48	                 backbone: ConfigType,
49	                 decode_head: ConfigType,
50	                 neck: OptConfigType = None,
51	                 auxiliary_head: OptConfigType = None,
52	                 loss_regularization: OptConfigType = None,
53	                 train_cfg: OptConfigType = None,
54	                 test_cfg: OptConfigType = None,
55	                 data_preprocessor: OptConfigType = None,
56	                 init_cfg: OptMultiConfig = None) -> None:
57	        super(Cylinder3D, self).__init__(
58	            backbone=backbone,
59	            decode_head=decode_head,
60	            neck=neck,
61	            auxiliary_head=auxiliary_head,
62	            loss_regularization=loss_regularization,
63	            train_cfg=train_cfg,
64	            test_cfg=test_cfg,
65	            data_preprocessor=data_preprocessor,
66	            init_cfg=init_cfg)
67	
68	        self.voxel_encoder = MODELS.build(voxel_encoder)
69	
70	    def extract_feat(self, batch_inputs: dict) -> Tensor:
71	        """Extract features from points."""
72	        encoded_feats = self.voxel_encoder(batch_inputs['voxels']['voxels'],
73	                                           batch_inputs['voxels']['coors'])
74	        batch_inputs['voxels']['voxel_coors'] = encoded_feats[1]
75	        x = self.backbone(encoded_feats[0], encoded_feats[1],
76	                          len(batch_inputs['points']))
77	        if self.with_neck:
78	            x = self.neck(x)
79	        return x
80	
81	    def loss(self, batch_inputs_dict: dict,
82	             batch_data_samples: SampleList) -> Dict[str, Tensor]:
83	        """Calculate losses from a batch of inputs and data samples.
84	
85	        Args:
86	            batch_inputs_dict (dict): Input sample dict which
87	                includes 'points' and 'imgs' keys.
88	
89	                - points (List[Tensor]): Point cloud of each sample.
90	                - imgs (Tensor, optional): Image tensor has shape (B, C, H, W).
91	            batch_data_samples (List[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]): The det3d data
92	                samples. It usually includes information such as `metainfo` and
93	                `gt_pts_seg`.
94	
95	        Returns:
96	            Dict[str, Tensor]: A dictionary of loss components.
97	        """
98	
99	        # extract features using backbone
100	        x = self.extract_feat(batch_inputs_dict)
101	        losses = dict()
102	        loss_decode = self._decode_head_forward_train(x, batch_data_samples)
103	        losses.update(loss_decode)
104	
105	        return losses
106	
107	    def predict(self,
108	                batch_inputs_dict: dict,
109	                batch_data_samples: SampleList,
110	                rescale: bool = True) -> SampleList:
111	        """Simple test with single scene.
112	
113	        Args:
114	            batch_inputs_dict (dict): Input sample dict which includes 'points'
115	                and 'imgs' keys.
116	
117	                - points (List[Tensor]): Point cloud of each sample.
118	                - imgs (Tensor, optional): Image tensor has shape (B, C, H, W).
119	            batch_data_samples (List[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]): The det3d data
120	                samples. It usually includes information such as `metainfo` and
121	                `gt_pts_seg`.
122	            rescale (bool): Whether transform to original number of points.
123	                Will be used for voxelization based segmentors.
124	                Defaults to True.
125	
126	        Returns:
127	            List[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]: Segmentation results of the input
128	            points. Each Det3DDataSample usually contains:
129	
130	            - ``pred_pts_seg`` (PointData): Prediction of 3D semantic
131	              segmentation.
132	            - ``pts_seg_logits`` (PointData): Predicted logits of 3D semantic
133	              segmentation before normalization.
134	        """
135	        # 3D segmentation requires per-point prediction, so it's impossible
136	        # to use down-sampling to get a batch of scenes with same num_points
137	        # therefore, we only support testing one scene every time
138	        x = self.extract_feat(batch_inputs_dict)
139	        seg_logits_list = self.decode_head.predict(x, batch_inputs_dict,
140	                                                   batch_data_samples)
141	        for i in range(len(seg_logits_list)):
142	            seg_logits_list[i] = seg_logits_list[i].transpose(0, 1)
143	
144	        return self.postprocess_result(seg_logits_list, batch_data_samples)

22	class AsymmResBlock(BaseModule):
23	    """Asymmetrical Residual Block.
24	
25	    Args:
26	        in_channels (int): Input channels of the block.
27	        out_channels (int): Output channels of the block.
28	        norm_cfg (:obj:`ConfigDict` or dict): Config dict for
29	            normalization layer.
30	        act_cfg (:obj:`ConfigDict` or dict): Config dict of activation layers.
31	            Defaults to dict(type='LeakyReLU').
32	        indice_key (str, optional): Name of indice tables. Defaults to None.
33	    """
34	
35	    def __init__(self,
36	                 in_channels: int,
37	                 out_channels: int,
38	                 norm_cfg: ConfigType,
39	                 act_cfg: ConfigType = dict(type='LeakyReLU'),
40	                 indice_key: Optional[str] = None):
41	        super().__init__()
42	
43	        self.conv0_0 = SubMConv3d(
44	            in_channels,
45	            out_channels,
46	            kernel_size=(1, 3, 3),
47	            padding=1,
48	            bias=False,
49	            indice_key=indice_key + 'bef')
50	        self.act0_0 = build_activation_layer(act_cfg)
51	        self.bn0_0 = build_norm_layer(norm_cfg, out_channels)[1]
52	
53	        self.conv0_1 = SubMConv3d(
54	            out_channels,
55	            out_channels,
56	            kernel_size=(3, 1, 3),
57	            padding=1,
58	            bias=False,
59	            indice_key=indice_key + 'bef')
60	        self.act0_1 = build_activation_layer(act_cfg)
61	        self.bn0_1 = build_norm_layer(norm_cfg, out_channels)[1]
62	
63	        self.conv1_0 = SubMConv3d(
64	            in_channels,
65	            out_channels,
66	            kernel_size=(3, 1, 3),
67	            padding=1,
68	            bias=False,
69	            indice_key=indice_key + 'bef')
70	        self.act1_0 = build_activation_layer(act_cfg)
71	        self.bn1_0 = build_norm_layer(norm_cfg, out_channels)[1]
72	
73	        self.conv1_1 = SubMConv3d(
74	            out_channels,
75	            out_channels,
76	            kernel_size=(1, 3, 3),
77	            padding=1,
78	            bias=False,
79	            indice_key=indice_key + 'bef')
80	        self.act1_1 = build_activation_layer(act_cfg)
81	        self.bn1_1 = build_norm_layer(norm_cfg, out_channels)[1]
82	
83	    def forward(self, x: SparseConvTensor) -> SparseConvTensor:
84	        """Forward pass."""
85	        shortcut = self.conv0_0(x)
86	
87	        shortcut.features = self.act0_0(shortcut.features)
88	        shortcut.features = self.bn0_0(shortcut.features)
89	
90	        shortcut = self.conv0_1(shortcut)
91	        shortcut.features = self.act0_1(shortcut.features)
92	        shortcut.features = self.bn0_1(shortcut.features)
93	
94	        res = self.conv1_0(x)
95	        res.features = self.act1_0(res.features)
96	        res.features = self.bn1_0(res.features)
97	
98	        res = self.conv1_1(res)
99	        res.features = self.act1_1(res.features)
100	        res.features = self.bn1_1(res.features)
101	
102	        res.features = res.features + shortcut.features
103	
104	        return res
105
